documentation: Dissolved oxygen, percent of air saturation. Inherits pv and the nested limits object from process_value; exists as its own type so the Explorer shows an InheritsFrom edge and a typed object, not a bare tag. Sets the units parameter and pv's engUnit to match. The pv entry is deliberately explicit: a subtype whose override list drops pv can lose pv on its instances when the definition is reloaded (seen 2026-09-18 on pressure and do), so every subtype restates it, and restates its history config with it so history cannot go the same way.
name: dissolved_oxygen

documentation: Vessel headspace pressure, bar gauge. Inherits from process_value; sets the units parameter and pv's engUnit to match, and restates pv's history config -- see dissolved_oxygen.
name: pressure

documentation: The band a process value is held to by the running operation. Its own type, nested in process_value as 'limits', because the i3X server re-sends an object's whole value document on any member change: kept as members of process_value, both limits would ride along with every pv tick. As a nested instance they are a HasComponent child of the process value, streamed as their own element only when the band moves, and a consumer that registers the parent with maxDepth 1 hears pv alone. Same engineering unit as the parent's pv; the unit is a parameter on the parent, read once from metadata. Not alarm limits; nothing evaluates them.
name: process_limits

tags.documentation: Upper bound of the band the running operation allows. Written by process_sim from the operation profile when the operation changes, so it is history alongside pv and the Explorer can draw the band the value was held to at any time.
tags.name: high_limit

tags.documentation: Lower bound of the band the running operation allows. See high_limit.
tags.name: low_limit

documentation: A measured process value as an i3X object. Its value document is {pv} and nothing else, on purpose: the server ships the whole document on every member change, so the only member that may change at pv's cadence is pv. Anything slower is either a nested component (limits, which change per operation) or a parameter (units, fixed at design time and served under the object's metadata rather than its value). Subtypes restate pv with its engUnit and its history config, and set the units parameter to match.
name: process_value

tags.documentation: The band this value is held to. A nested object so it streams on its own cadence; see process_limits.
tags.name: limits

tags.documentation: Process value. Simulated by process_sim on the process-sim timer: it settles toward the running operation's target with a little noise, so an advance is visible here as a ramp. Memory tag; no instrument behind it, and nothing in the stack reads it -- it exists so the vessel's i3X object carries something that moves. Subtypes set engUnit here and the units parameter to the same string: engUnit is what the tag carries, the parameter is what the i3X object serves in metadata.
tags.name: pv

documentation: Vessel temperature, degrees C. Inherits from process_value; sets the units parameter and pv's engUnit to match, and restates pv's history config -- see dissolved_oxygen.
name: temperature
